test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of July 2022, under which of the Social Security Insurance schemes is insurance provided with a premium of Rs. 20 per annum that is to be deducted from the account holder's bank account through auto-debit' facility in one instalment?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Under the **Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)**, insurance is provided with a premium of Rs. 20 per annum.
 
• This premium is deducted from the account holder's bank account through an auto-debit facility in one installment.
